experiment: E73 BCIC IV-2a cross-session supervised contrastive identity embedding

data.unobserved_channel_policy: 14 target channels are zero placeholders marked False; never interpreted as measured signals
data.artifact_policy: retain and report; do not select trials by artifact status

model.type: E54 EEGNet temporal/depthwise/separable encoder, SupCon only
model.unused_e54_heads: prototypes and radius_raw are excluded from optimization; retained only for source-compatible state_dict

training.loss: cross-session-only supervised contrastive loss; positives have the same subject and the opposite session
training.epoch_selection: none; fixed final epoch, no outer feedback
training.fit_capacity: reported only as a diagnostic, never as generalization evidence

protocol.threshold: q05 of inner-known run-4 confidence; no unknown-based threshold selection
protocol.outer_rule: run each fixed outer fold once; all methods are descriptive and no outer-based selection is allowed

gates.aggregation: mean over three outer folds and two session directions for the primary method

reporting.AUC: report both same/different query-template pair AUROC and known/unknown detection AUROC
reporting.F1: identity macro-F1 and unknown-F1 at the inner-known q05 threshold
reporting.official_score: N/A in this clean external experiment
reporting.test: N/A; competition Train and Test are not read
